title: Bound the resend of a verification bind on an unknown Engram error code
outcome: An Engram error code that the bind classification does not know (for example invalid_request, or the answer of an Engram build without verification_bind) settles the member with a line its holder is told, instead of being resent with identical bytes without end and never giving the holder a line.
acceptance: Bound the resend of a verification bind on an unknown Engram error code is done
disposal_reason: The Claude review of w-540531f46f53 slice (i), round 2 (delegation-c2894412), raised this Low to a Medium, so it is fixed inside that change rather than separately. engram_bind_outcome now resends only control_request_expired, control_store_busy and storage_error, the codes in Engram src/host.rs store_error_code that a resend can settle. Every other remote code, an unknown one included, settles as Final with a line for the holder. Tests cover invalid_request, store_not_initialized, task_access_denied and an unknown code. It lands with w-540531f46f53.
